text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Hero...
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S claims victory in the
Arima 
Kinen. Zenno Rob Roy looked up to the 
heavens and let out a fierce roar of 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Hero...
text_block_list.text:
Whether she became a lingering regret for 
Symboli Kris S remains unknown, and her 
retirement wasn't canceled. ...However, 
she could feel the impact she had made.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Hero...
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Tenno Sho
(Spring). 
Zenno Rob Roy won't halt her strides— so 
that when she returns,
she can welcome her as a true champion.
